info.title: PDF to Text & Markdown Extractor: OCR, DOCX, RAG chunks
info.description:
Turn PDF and Word files into clean Markdown text. Scanned pages are read with OCR, and the text comes split into RAG-ready chunks with heading paths.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/pdf-docx-to-markdown
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/pdf-docx-to-markdown
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/pdf-docx-to-markdown

application/json.schema:
{
  "title": "PDF to Text & Markdown Extractor input",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "documentUrls": {
      "title": "PDF or DOCX file URLs",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Direct links to PDF or Word (.docx) files. Each file becomes one dataset row with its Markdown text. Up to 50 MB per file.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "prefill": [
        "https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762",
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocrmypdf/OCRmyPDF/main/tests/resources/skew.pdf"
      ],
      "default": [
        "https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762",
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocrmypdf/OCRmyPDF/main/tests/resources/skew.pdf"
      ]
    },
    "ocrMode": {
      "title": "OCR for scanned pages",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "auto: OCR only pages with no text layer (scanned pages). always: OCR every page. off: never OCR.",
      "editor": "select",
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "always",
        "off"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Auto (scanned pages only)",
        "Always (every page)",
        "Off"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "ocrLanguage": {
      "title": "OCR language",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Language of the scanned text. Combine with +, e.g. eng+fra.",
      "editor": "select",
      "enum": [
        "eng",
        "fra",
        "deu",
        "spa",
        "por",
        "ita",
        "nld",
        "eng+fra",
        "eng+spa",
        "eng+deu"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "English",
        "French",
        "German",
        "Spanish",
        "Portuguese",
        "Italian",
        "Dutch",
        "English + French",
        "English + Spanish",
        "English + German"
      ],
      "default": "eng"
    },
    "pageRange": {
      "title": "Page range (PDF)",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only convert these pages, e.g. 1-5,8 or 10-last. Empty converts every page up to the page limit.",
      "editor": "textfield"
    },
    "maxPagesPerDocument": {
      "title": "Max pages per PDF",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Stop after this many pages of each PDF (1 to 500).",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500,
      "default": 200
    },
    "chunkSize": {
      "title": "Chunk size (tokens)",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Split the Markdown into retrieval chunks of about this many tokens (1 token = about 4 characters). Chunks respect headings, paragraphs and sentences. 0 turns chunking off.",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 4000,
      "default": 400
    },
    "chunkOverlap": {
      "title": "Chunk overlap (tokens)",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Tokens repeated from the end of one chunk at the start of the next.",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "default": 40
    },
    "chunksAsRows": {
      "title": "One row per chunk",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "On: each chunk is its own dataset row (ready for a vector database). Off: one row per document with a chunks list.",
      "default": false
    },
    "includeMarkdown": {
      "title": "Include full Markdown",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Off leaves the markdown field empty and keeps only the chunks (smaller rows). Ignored when one row per chunk is on.",
      "default": true
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "documentUrls"
  ]
}
